title: Resume a multipart upload after ownership transfer
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Preserve accepted parts, reconcile on the new owner, upload only missing parts and verify final bytes, SHA-256 and the original completion budget.
preconditions: A standard browser with local HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Web Crypto.
One in-memory four-part ASCII fixture and two synthetic ownership epochs.
Shared durable storage and long-work continuation are assumptions, not native prerequisites certified by this lesson.
No account, server, network, credential or application framework.
actions: Choose storage, resume policy, listing availability, part integrity and integer time budgets.
Start, pause, transfer ownership, optionally probe a stale writer, resume and verify.
Inspect byte/hash, preservation, duplication and original-clock measurements.
Check a prediction separately from synthetic user impact.
Reset to defaults without erasing any started-run result or replenishing limits.
assertions: Shared accepted parts survive ownership transfer and are not uploaded twice.
Final part count, byte length and Web Crypto SHA-256 match the fixed original.
Completion at or below the original budget succeeds; retries do not reset it.
Part loss, duplication, corruption and known deadline breaches are failures.
Missing listing or hash evidence is unknown and cannot override a known failure.
Stale ownership epochs have no accepted-part or upload effects.
Invalid input/state actions do not mutate the run; reset retains all outcomes.

iac.stage: After genuine behavioral RED; before implementation

verification.tooling: Existing Node 22.23.4, offline Playwright 1.56.1, installed signed Edge 156 only

limits: No actual HTTP multipart, persisted object storage, network latency or native Azure proof.
Synthetic epoch fencing is not authentication or a distributed concurrency guarantee.
B-S043 still requires approved CORE, DATA, HOST, OBJECT and C024 native gates.
D-S039, D-S042 and original D-S043 acceptance remain unfulfilled native work.
No production runtime, deployment or five-nines reliability certification.
